# Maintainers

BuildMax is currently maintained by:

| Maintainer | Role | Responsibilities |
|---|---|---|
| [@gougoujiang](https://github.com/gougoujiang) | Project owner | Direction, review, releases, security coordination, and repository administration |

## Expectations

Maintainers are expected to:

- triage issues and pull requests in a reasonable, best-effort timeframe
- keep project decisions and release notes visible in the repository
- protect reporter privacy for security and conduct reports
- disclose conflicts of interest and step back from decisions when appropriate
- follow the merge and decision process in [GOVERNANCE.md](GOVERNANCE.md)

BuildMax is an alpha project maintained on a best-effort basis. The project
does not currently promise a commercial support SLA; see
[SUPPORT.md](SUPPORT.md) for support channels and expectations.

## Adding or Removing Maintainers

Changes to the maintainer list are proposed by pull request. The project owner
makes the final decision after considering sustained contributions, review
quality, reliability, and community conduct. A departing maintainer should be
removed from `CODEOWNERS` and repository access in the same change.
